_note: 聽力（listening）島 sidecar：一頁多單元。strand=listening。6 個單元覆蓋 10 個知識點：L1 看圖辨義（picture-id，初級）；L2 辨音＋重音語調（phonology／stress-intonation，中級）；L3 問答回應＋短對話理解（response／short-dialogue，中級）；L4 轉折訊號詞＋數字時間價格日期（transition-cue／numbers，中級）；L5 聽寫（dictation，中級）；L6 短獨白／廣播抓重點＋言外之意推論（monologue／implication，高級）。英語島治理：語感＞文法、聽寫＋跟讀＋語調模仿為核心練習模態，英文學英文（R14＝teach 的 body 全英文、中文對照放 zh_hint 預設收合），國小情境化、不教台式對比。聽力音檔是內容核心：每個需要「聽」的 teach 例與 practice 題皆帶 audio ref＋audio_script（音檔要唸的完整英文字句，edge-tts 可唸；絕不放孤立音素 IPA）。音檔 ref 命名 lis_<unit簡碼>_<ex|q|dict|sh><N>（簡碼：pic＝picture-id、ss＝sounds-stress、qa＝qa-dialogue、cn＝cue-numbers、dict＝dictation、mono＝monologue），全檔唯一，音檔稍後由 edge-tts 產生。辨音最小對立對 audio_script 放完整字或句（不放孤立 IPA）。聽寫／跟讀類自評＝翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）。英文句子／對話／讀音皆以 Cambridge Dictionary 等權威查證、status:provisional、待英語母語 reviewer 複核。學習者端零年段字樣。（由 english_listening.units.json 拆出的單一單元新引擎頁，內容沿用；HD 2026-11-03 新版可重用舊 material）

units.title_zh: 短獨白聽解與言外之意
units.can_do: 我能聽短獨白或廣播抓住主旨和重要細節，也能從線索推測說話者沒有直接說出的言外之意和心情。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: In a short talk or announcement, the main idea is often stated near the beginning, and details like time, place, and instructions come after. Listen for the topic first, then the key details.
claims.verification_ref: 短獨白／廣播的主旨常在開頭，時間、地點、指示等細節在後；先抓主題再抓關鍵細節；英語聽力教學通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Sometimes a speaker's meaning is not said directly; you infer it from clues. For example, 'I've read this page three times and I still don't get it' implies the speaker finds it difficult.
claims.verification_ref: 說話者的意思有時不直說，要從線索推論；例如「這頁我讀三次還是不懂」隱含覺得很難；語用推論通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A speaker's word choice and the situation can show how they feel (happy, worried, annoyed) even when they do not say it directly. 'The bus just left without me' usually signals annoyance.
claims.verification_ref: 說話者的用字與情境能顯示心情（開心／擔心／懊惱），即使沒直說；「公車剛好丟下我開走了」通常表示懊惱；語用／語氣推論通則；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: A monologue is one person speaking, like an announcement or a short talk. The main idea often comes near the start; the details — time, place, and what to do — come after. Catch the main point first, then hold the key details.
teach.zh_hint: 獨白是一個人在說話，像廣播或一段短講。主旨常在開頭出現，細節（時間、地點、要做什麼）在後面。先抓住重點，再記住關鍵細節。

teach.audio_script: Attention, shoppers. The store will close in ten minutes. Please bring your items to the counter now.
teach.body: Listen to the announcement. Main idea: the store is closing soon. Key details: in ten minutes, and you should go to the counter now.
teach.zh_hint: 聽這則廣播。主旨：商店快關門了。關鍵細節：還有十分鐘，現在要把東西拿去櫃台結帳。

teach.body: Sometimes a speaker does not say the meaning directly. You work it out from clues — the words, the situation, and the tone. For example, 'It's getting cold in here' can be an indirect way of asking someone to close a window.
teach.zh_hint: 有時說話者不會直接說出意思，你要從線索推論——用字、情境、語氣。例如 It's getting cold in here.（這裡越來越冷了。）可能是在委婉請人把窗戶關上。

teach.audio_script: It's already nine o'clock, and the bus still isn't here.
teach.body: Listen: 'It's already nine o'clock, and the bus still isn't here.' The speaker does not say 'I am worried', but the words 'already' and 'still isn't here' suggest the bus is late and the speaker is worried.
teach.zh_hint: 聽：It's already nine o'clock, and the bus still isn't here.（都已經九點了，公車還沒來。）說話者沒說「我很擔心」，但 already（都已經）和 still isn't here（還沒來）暗示公車遲到、說話者有點擔心。

practice.stem: 聽這則廣播，它最主要想告訴學生什麼？
practice.audio_script: Good morning, students. Today's art class is moved from Room 5 to the library. Please go there at two o'clock.

distractor_rationales.美術課取消了: 廣播說課「改地點」（moved to the library），不是取消。
distractor_rationales.圖書館要關閉: 廣播說美術課改到圖書館上，不是圖書館關閉。

practice.feedback: 廣播主旨：art class is moved … to the library（美術課改到圖書館），兩點去。

practice.stem: 聽這則廣播，火車從幾號月台出發？
practice.audio_script: The train to London leaves from platform three at six fifteen.

distractor_rationales.六號月台: six 是時間 six fifteen（6:15）的一部分，不是月台號碼。
distractor_rationales.十五號月台: fifteen 是時間 six fifteen 的分鐘，不是月台號碼。
distractor_rationales.五號月台: 廣播說的是 platform three（三號月台）。

practice.feedback: 廣播說 platform three（三號月台）、six fifteen（6:15）出發，所以月台是三號。

practice.stem: 聽這句話，說話者的言外之意最可能是什麼？
practice.answer: 他覺得這段內容很難懂
practice.audio_script: I've read this page three times and I still don't get it.
options: 他覺得這段內容很難懂

distractor_rationales.他已經完全讀懂了: 他說 still don't get it（還是不懂），表示沒讀懂。
distractor_rationales.他覺得這頁很無聊: 他說的是「不懂」，不是「無聊」。
distractor_rationales.他讀得很快很輕鬆: 讀了三次還不懂，表示讀得很吃力，不是輕鬆。

practice.feedback: read … three times and still don't get it（讀三次還是不懂），言外之意＝他覺得很難懂。

practice.stem: 聽這句話，說話者現在的心情最可能是？
practice.audio_script: Oh, great. The bus just left without me.

distractor_rationales.非常開心: 雖然他說 great，但公車丟下他開走是壞事，這裡是反話，其實不開心。
distractor_rationales.覺得無所謂: 錯過公車對他有影響，從語氣聽得出他在意。

practice.feedback: 公車 left without me（丟下我開走了）是壞事；這裡 Oh, great 是反話，說話者其實懊惱、不開心。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。讀廣播時用清楚、穩定的播報語氣；讀言外之意的句子時，試著用語氣帶出說話者的心情。

lines.text: Attention, shoppers. The store will close in ten minutes.
lines.audio_script: Attention, shoppers. The store will close in ten minutes.
lines.intonation: 廣播語氣、清楚穩定；ten minutes 唸清楚

lines.text: It's already nine o'clock, and the bus still isn't here.
lines.audio_script: It's already nine o'clock, and the bus still isn't here.
lines.intonation: 語氣帶一點著急；already 和 still 稍微加重
